definition: [ לָקַשׁ ] verb only Pi`el 3 masculine plural, probably denominative from לֶקֶשׁ = take the aftermath , i.e. take everything ( Wetzst in De Hiob 26, 6 ) (> Buhl II. לקשׁ , compare Arabic schnell zusammenraffen [compare Lane 2668 ]); — despoil ; וְכֶרֶם רָשָׁע יְלֵַקּשׁוּ ׃ Job 24:6 and the vineyard of the wicked (but read probably עָשִׁיר the rich Bu Du ) they despoil (|| קָצַר ).
